headline: Liqvd Digital makes Adlift wholly owned subsidiary
summary: Liqvd Digital India Limited acquired the remaining 23.21% stake in Adlift Marketing for ₹9.00 crore, making it a wholly owned subsidiary funded by IPO proceeds.

headline: Meson Valves posts H1FY27 loss of ₹1,369.56 lakh
summary: Quest Flow Controls (formerly Meson Valves) reported a half-year loss of ₹1,369.56 lakh for H1FY27, compared to a profit of ₹150.49 lakh in H1FY26.

headline: Tata Motors hits 89.42% in Iveco tender offer
summary: Tata Motors' subsidiary reached 89.42% shareholding in Iveco Group via a voluntary tender offer, satisfying the threshold condition. Final results due by October 29.

headline: Sumichem Q2 results: Net profit falls, misses estimates
summary: Sumichem reported Q2 consolidated net profit of 1.57b rupees, down from 1.78b YoY and below the 1.62b estimate. Revenue fell to 9.07b rupees vs 9.3b, while EBITDA margin contracted to 20.47% from 23.45%.

headline: Stocks in News: Sona BLW, Paracables, Aegis in focus
summary: Q2 earnings drive market moves as Sona BLW rallies 3.9% on strong EV growth, while Dalmia Bharat slips despite dividend declaration.

headline: HDFC Bank appoints Anup Bagchi as new MD & CEO
summary: Anup Bagchi assumes charge as MD & CEO of HDFC Bank on October 27, 2026, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan who vacated office after completing his tenure.

headline: Mobavenue AI Tech launches ResurgeX in US
summary: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited launched ResurgeX, an AI-powered app retargeting platform, in the United States on October 27, 2026, targeting a $413 billion digital ad market.

headline: VA Tech Wabag wins ₹1,000 crore+ order from RIL
summary: VA Tech Wabag secures a major order from Reliance Industries for a desalination and remineralization plant in Jamnagar, valued at over ₹1,000 crore.

headline: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight on Urban Company
summary: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight rating on Urban Company with a target price of ₹190, citing structural improvement in India consumer-services NTV excluding InstaHelp.

headline: Citi maintains Sell on Supreme Industries, target ₹3,000
summary: Citi maintains Sell on Supreme Industries with a target price of ₹3,000. Q2 EBITDA rose 45% YoY to ₹4.3bn, around 8% above estimates, aided by 19% volume growth.

headline: Mankind Pharma Q2FY27: Analysts split on valuation
summary: Mankind Pharma Q2FY27 saw revenue beat estimates by 3%. While EBITDA margin hit 27%, consumer healthcare growth slowed to 1.2%, prompting mixed analyst ratings.

headline: Tata Consumer targets 17-20% EBITDA margin in 3 years
summary: Tata Consumer Products aims for 17-20% EBITDA margins within three years. Management projects 25-30% growth for Capital Foods and Organic India, and 30% for RTD beverages.

headline: India-US trade deal talks nearing next stage: Goyal
summary: India and the US are fine-tuning their bilateral trade deal, with discussions advancing to the next stage, according to Piyush Goyal.

headline: BPCL to cut Russian oil buys as West Asian crude gains edge
summary: Bharat Petroleum plans to reduce Russian crude purchases as higher freight costs and elevated premiums make West Asian oil more competitive, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Centre clears regulatory path for E100 flex-fuel vehicles
summary: The Centre has cleared the regulatory path for OEM-certified E100 flex-fuel vehicles. Wider adoption remains dependent on automaker launches and fuel distribution infrastructure.

headline: India cotton demand-supply gap to exceed 9 million bales
summary: India's cotton demand-supply gap is expected to exceed 9 million bales in 2026-27, driven by lower domestic output due to El Niño and rising export demand.

headline: NBFCs curb lending in drought-hit rural areas
summary: Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, and M&M Finance are monitoring vulnerable districts and tightening exposure in drought-affected rural markets, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Honda shelves India EV plant with 600,000-unit capacity
summary: Honda has shelved plans for an electric vehicle plant in India that had an initial annual production capacity of 600,000 units, even as rivals expand their manufacturing capabilities.

headline: RailTel secures ₹132 crore contract
summary: RailTel Corporation of India Ltd has secured a new contract valued at ₹132 crore, expanding its order book and reinforcing its position in the telecom infrastructure sector.

headline: Exhicon appoints Nilesh Dubey as CEO Venue Dev
summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions appoints Nilesh Kumar Dubey as CEO-Venue Development to lead Mohali project launch by May 2027.

headline: RailTel wins ₹27.38 crore order from Cotton Corporation
summary: RailTel Corporation of India secured a ₹27.38 crore order from Cotton Corporation of India for disaster recovery solutions, with completion set for November 30, 2031.

headline: Coforge partners with Driving Forward for Chicago students
summary: Coforge has teamed up with Driving Forward to create job opportunities for first-generation and underserved college students in Chicago, expanding its community engagement initiatives.

headline: LTM secures $100M global banking deal
summary: LTM Limited has secured a strategic engagement with a global banking firm worth up to $100 million. The two-year deal focuses on technology consolidation and AI-led delivery.

headline: MTAR Technologies shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 36,397 MTAR Technologies shares changing hands on NSE at ₹6,895.00, with a combined value of ₹25.10 crore.

headline: HAL shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 36,462 HAL shares changing hands on NSE at ₹4887.20, with a combined value of ₹17.82 crore.

headline: Onelife Capital converts warrants in Swojas Foods
summary: Onelife Capital Advisors converted 16 lakh equity share warrants into shares of Swojas Foods on October 24, 2026. The holding in voting shares rose to 17.72%.

headline: OneSource Pharma Q2FY27: PAT jumps 132% YoY
summary: OneSource Specialty Pharma reported a consolidated net profit of ₹574.84 million in Q2FY27, up 132% YoY. Revenue rose 37% to ₹5,162 million, driven by strong CDMO demand.

headline: OneSource Pharma board approves director reclassification
summary: OneSource Specialty Pharma's board approved changing Dr. Claudio Albrecht from Independent to Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Vintex Tools acquires 13,000 Shakti Pumps shares
summary: Vintex Tools & Machineries Private Limited acquired 13,000 equity shares of Shakti Pumps (India) Limited in the open market on October 26, 2026.

headline: DLF shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 18,74,490 DLF shares changing hands on BSE at ₹670.15, with a combined value of ₹125.62 crore.

headline: Garware Offshore settles Afcons dues for ₹2.93 crore
summary: Garware Offshore Services Limited settled a ₹3.16 crore IBC claim against Afcons Infrastructure for a net amount of ₹2.93 crore, resolving the outstanding debt.

headline: TVS Motors shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 70,290 TVS Motors shares changing hands on NSE at ₹4,048.90 per share, for a combined value of ₹28.46 crore.

headline: LIC Housing Finance shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,500,125 LIC Housing Finance shares changing hands on BSE at ₹508.30, with a combined value of ₹76.25 crore.

headline: Rajasthan Global Securities crosses 5% stake in Premier Explosives
summary: Rajasthan Global Securities Private Limited acquired 1,64,297 shares of Premier Explosives Ltd on October 23, 2026. This open market purchase raised its holding to 5.02% of total voting capital.

headline: Max Healthcare approves PRSU scheme and CMD pay
summary: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd members approved a new Performance Linked Restricted Stock Unit scheme for 2026 and remuneration for CMD Abhay Soi via postal ballot.

headline: Invesco MF crosses 5% stake in Sahajanand Medical
summary: Invesco Mutual Fund increased its holding in Sahajanand Medical Technologies to 5.05% after acquiring a 4.35% stake via open market purchases on October 23, 2026.

headline: Hemo Organic promoter sells 1.55 lakh shares
summary: Dineshbhai Shanabhai Patel, promoter of Hemo Organic Limited, disposed of 1,55,986 equity shares via off-market sale on October 24, 2026.

headline: Cholamandalam Investment shares flag large trade
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 264,137 shares of Cholamandalam Investment changing hands at ₹1,467.90 on NSE, with combined value of ₹38.77 crore.

headline: Torrent Pharmaceuticals shares flag large trade on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 60,000 Torrent Pharmaceuticals shares on BSE at ₹4,630.00, with a combined value of ₹27.78 crore.

headline: Genz and Aikyata raise Quanto Agroworld stake to 6.23%
summary: Genz Investment Advisors and Aikyata Advisory LLP acquired 3,54,000 shares of Quanto Agroworld Ltd in open market deals on Oct 23, 2026.

headline: PMC Fincorp appoints Atul Malik as CEO
summary: PMC Fincorp Limited appointed Atul Narendra Malik as CEO effective October 27, 2026. Malik brings 22 years of experience in equity capital markets and investment banking.

headline: Taril plans ₹1,250 crore investment in three new plants
summary: Taril plans to invest ₹1,250 crore in three new manufacturing plants to strengthen India's power infrastructure and create over 1,000 jobs.

headline: SVF II OSTRICH sells 5.5 crore Ola Electric shares
summary: SVF II OSTRICH (DE) LLC disposed of 55,499,195 equity shares and 11,225,054 rights entitlements in Ola Electric Mobility between January and October 2026.

headline: Mayank Cattle Food H1FY27 profit jumps 120%
summary: Mayank Cattle Food Ltd reported a 120% YoY rise in half-year net profit to ₹554.61 lakh. Revenue from operations grew 12.6% to ₹2,086.72 crore.

headline: One Point One Solutions wins WORLDCOB Silver award
summary: One Point One Solutions Limited secured a Silver award at WORLDCOB's THE BIZZ Awards, with six leaders honoured. Q1FY27 revenue rose 129.4% YoY to ₹158.32 crore.

headline: Core4 Engineers IPO Day 3 Update
summary: Core4 Engineers IPO is subscribed 1.34x on Day 3. bHNI demand leads at 6.22x, while QIB interest remains at zero.

headline: SFC Env Tech IPO Day 1: Subscribed 0.04x
summary: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO saw weak Day 1 demand with overall subscription at 0.04x. Retail led at 0.07x, while QIB interest remained nil.

headline: Wiscon IPO Day 1: QIBs Lead Demand
summary: Wiscon Industries IPO saw QIB subscription at 2.00x on Day 1, while Retail lagged at 0.07x. Total issue subscribed 0.68x so far.

headline: EAAA IPO Day 2: Subscribed 0.13x
summary: EAAA India Alternatives IPO sees sluggish demand on Day 2, with overall subscription at 0.13x. QIB interest remains minimal at 0.08x.

headline: BLS Polymers IPO Day 1: Subscribed 3.47x
summary: BLS Polymers IPO sees strong Day 1 response with overall subscription at 3.47x. QIB demand leads at 7.49x, while Retail bids clock in at 1.74x.
